title: Pan-Seared Duck Bao with Hoisin Glaze
description: A twist on the classic Chinese bao, this recipe features pan-seared duck breast served in a soft, fluffy bun with a sweet and sticky hoisin glaze.
instructions: Season the duck breast with salt and sesame oil.
Pan-sear the duck breast in a hot skillet until browned on both sides.
Transfer the duck to the oven and cook until the internal temperature reaches 135°F (57°C).
Meanwhile, combine hoisin sauce, brown sugar, soy sauce, and rice vinegar in a small saucepan.
Bring the glaze to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Slice the cooked duck into thin strips.
Split the bao buns in half and toast until lightly browned.
Assemble the bao by spreading a layer of hoisin glaze on the bottom bun, followed by a few slices of duck, some scallions, and a sprinkle of ginger.
Top with the top bun and serve immediately.
